final_text:
7 of the 10 expected species were called present, plus 1 species that is not on the list.

The report has 20 species-level (S) rows totalling 237,500 clade reads. I converted each to a percent of that total and called anything at 0.1% or above present. Eight species qualify:

| Species (as reported) | Clade reads | % of species reads | Expected? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Limosilactobacillus fermentum | 146,108 | 61.52 | Yes (the allowed rename of Lactobacillus fermentum) |
| Bacillus spizizenii | 37,874 | 15.95 | **No** |
| Enterococcus faecalis | 34,730 | 14.62 | Yes |
| Pseudomonas aeruginosa | 9,018 | 3.80 | Yes |
| Staphylococcus aureus | 3,591 | 1.51 | Yes |
| Salmonella enterica | 3,072 | 1.29 | Yes |
| Escherichia coli | 2,191 | 0.92 | Yes |
| Listeria monocytogenes | 811 | 0.34 | Yes |

- **Not called:** Bacillus subtilis, Saccharomyces cerevisiae and Cryptococcus neoformans. None of them has a species row at 0.1% or above. No species row falls between 0.05% and 0.1%, so none of them narrowly missed the cutoff.
- **The one extra species:** Bacillus spizizenii counts as a false call. It may well stand in for the expected Bacillus subtilis, but only the fermentum rename was allowed, so I didn't merge them.

RESULT: {"found": 7, "false": 1}

cd /c/Temp/mc/agent_eval/sandbox_bare; cat truth/mock_even.tsv; python -I -c "
import gzip
rows=[l.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for l in gzip.open('data/even.report.gz','rt')]
s=[(r[5].strip(),int(r[1])) for r in rows if len(r)>=6 and r[3].strip()=='S']
t=sum(c for _,c in s);print('total',t,len(s))
for n,c in sorted(s,key=lambda x:-x[1]):
  p=100*c/t
  if p>=0.05: print(repr(n),c,round(p,4))
"
